title: The Week That Was
gist: Lawfare's weekly roundup summarizes its coverage including Trump administration litigation (Comey cases, East Potomac Park, National Guard deployment), the Iran war eight months in, and Israel's Oct. 27 elections. Investor-relevant pieces cover Hungary's Russian energy dependence, an EU-China hybrid car quota deal, Taiwan export-control alignment, China's progress toward domestic lithography, and the dilemma of regulating open-weight AI via export controls.
